name: split-selected-pane-wears-the-ring-and-cmd-w-closes-it
description:
The command bar's /note opens the notes pad beside the page, which is the one keyboard path into a split. The page keeps the primary card on the left and stays the selected pane, so the accent ring draws on the left card's edge: the two columns at x=266, white before the split, reads crimson after. A Cmd+Opt link click opens a little window now, and a row dropped on its own window tears off, so neither opens a split here. The click-then-Cmd+W half lives in AtriumBrowserWindowBrowserTest.TheSelectedSplitPaneWearsTheRingAndCmdWClosesOnlyIt.

The fixture stages 260, so the card starts at x=267 and its top edge sits around y=40.

actions.note: /note closes the palette itself once the fifth key lands, and the query never reaches the bridge's length log
park the pointer off the card edge that is read
